metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Son Of
metas.description: An entitled son sues his father for neglecting his duties. The father's powerful response sparks a courtroom battle that teaches the son about responsibility, love, and family.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Bhartha Mahasayulaku Wignyapthi
metas.description: What begins as a casual fling between a married man, Ram a.k.a Satya and Manasa in the middle of an international business trip, balloons into an out-of-the-blue mess when the latter lands in Hyderabad, disrupting Ram’s otherwise stable marriage with Balamani.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2026 · Irumudi
metas.description: Follows an alcohol-addicted father with a violent past who lives peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall and decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha at her request.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Biker
metas.description: A seasoned motocross rider returns to the grueling sport he once abandoned, confronting fierce competition and a father who might push him to the brink.
